status: analysis refined on original exploratory cohort and frozen before controlled evaluation; training plan separately frozen before controlled training
exploration: 30 existing heterogeneous MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/KMNIST runs, stratified 18/6/6 split; pipeline development only

controlled_cohorts.one_bit: 200 independent seeds, paired AB/BA then 5 C epochs
controlled_cohorts.multi_bit: 200 other independent seeds, 4 independently drawn order bits plus complementary history, then 5 C epochs

training: full 60000 MNIST training images and 10000 test images, 784-64-10, one epoch per A/B window; frozen zero biases; SGD lr .1 momentum .9 batch256; reset momentum at every task window boundary; same within-seed init and image order

splits.group: whole independent initialization seed, both arms kept together

alignment: local canonical ReLU gauge at each time, permutation inferred only from final weights against first train row and frozen across all checkpoints
targets: train-only centered trajectory PCA with train-only layer RMS scaling; dimensions 8 primary, 16/32 sensitivity
input: aligned canonical final weights only; train-only centering/scaling, W0/W1/both variants
trajectory_probe: dual ridge; alpha selected on validation from [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10] separately by time/target/dimension/layer; fixed training fits, no train+val refit
primary_trajectory_endpoint: t0 absolute coordinate, both layers, PCA8, ridge, held-out variance-weighted R2; compare mean and persistence MSE
baselines: mean training early position minus known final coordinate (displacement control added after exploration, before controlled evaluation)
event_probe: linear L2 least-squares classifier; same alpha grid and validation squared-loss tuning separately by bit; threshold .5
primary_event_endpoint: earliest bit, both layers, ridge_classifier, held-out accuracy, in multi_bit cohort
secondary_probe: 32 hidden-unit ReLU MLP, final-only train PCA32 input, Adam lr .003 weight_decay .001, 300 fullbatch steps; validation chooses epoch every5 steps

inference.bootstrap: 1000 resamples of entire held-out seeds, percentile95 CI, conditional on selected probe and fixed split
inference.event_permutation: 999 independent whole-history swaps within each seed; repeat fitting and validation tuning; p=(exceedances+1)/1000; Holm over all 6 feature sets times number of bits within cohort
inference.trajectory_permutation: 999 test-only whole-seed target-block permutations conditional on fixed trained probe; MSE statistic, Holm over times for primary both/PCA8/absolute/ridge family
inference.limitations: event randomization tests global history exchangeability, does not isolate one bit causally; 999 permutations have .001 minimum p; exploratory heterogeneous cohort receives no inferential permutation p-values

negative_controls: seed-wise swapped whole history labels with full validation tuning
validation: C transition exact replay after momentum reset
held-out early perturbation cannot change final features
scope_limits: No exact high-dimensional inverse-SGD claim; no extrapolation to other data/models/C durations; exploratory old runs provide no reliable generalization claim; fixed split only; no power guarantee.
